notes.title: Alessia's Dollhouse Major Update
notes.content:
General Changes:

    Brightness Settings: The game's brightness settings have been adjusted.

    Difficulty Modes: Three difficulty modes have been added: Easy, Normal, and Hard.

Difficulty Mode Specific Changes:

    Easy Mode:

        Vex's speed has been reduced.

        Nina's speed has been reduced.

        Despawn time has been shortened.

        Spawn time has been lengthened.

    Normal Mode:

        Nina's speed has been decreased.

        Despawn time has been decreased.

    Hard Mode:

        Spawn times have been shortened.

        Nina's speed has been increased.

Other Changes:

    Translations: The game's translations have been updated.

    Horror Elements: Additional horror elements have been added to the game.

    Achievements: New achievements have been added that are tied to difficulty modes.

Information:

    New features are not active in old saves.

- New achievements have been added that are tied to difficulty modes.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.2
notes.content:
-Keep the lights on bug fixed. You now have a few seconds to turn them back on after all the lights are turned off

-Alessia's speed has been increased

-Updated an achievement

-Fixed in-game notes glitching

-Fixed dying when big sis disappears bug

-Light adjustments made

[b]Warning:[/b] Updates may corrupt old save files, please start the new game for the best experience.
